title: Fork code never runs on a lab GPU host: workflow structure and the maintainer procedure

required_workflow_properties: every runs-on is a GitHub-hosted ubuntu image
triggers are exactly push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch
tests launched through scripts/run_suite.py cpu-pr without --gpu-required
required_policy_statements: fork pull requests never execute on the lab hosts
checkout by commit hash into an isolated worktree and venv under .local
cleanup of worktree and venv after the run

observables.name: policy_statements
observables.definition: the policy statements above are present

acceptance.rule: every listed property and statement holds; a self-hosted runner or a pull_request_target trigger anywhere in the workflow file fails the test

notes: A workflow approval click is not a review; the policy says so explicitly.
